target.title: fix(ollama): use CJK-aware char estimate for usage fallback
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Ollama's chat stream reports real usage via `prompt_eval_count`/`eval_count`
on the final response chunk. When those fields are missing or invalid (e.g. a
native stream that ends early), `extensions/ollama/src/stream.ts` falls back
to estimating tokens as `chars / 4` using plain UTF-16 `.length` on the
message content, tool-call JSON, and tool names.

That heuristic assumes ~4 chars/token, which holds for Latin/English text but
badly undercounts CJK (Chinese/Japanese/Korean) text, which tokenizes at
roughly 1 char/token. For CJK-heavy conversations that hit this fallback path,
usage is undercounted by 2-4x.

This fallback usage feeds `assistantMessage.usage`, which is used both for
usage/context telemetry (`/context`, treemap, totals) and for
`calculateContextTokens` → `shouldCompact` proactive context-window
compaction decisions. Undercounting on CJK sessions means the agent believes
it has more context headroom than it actually does, delaying proactive
compaction until the provider itself errors on overflow.

## Why This Change Was Made

The codebase already has a shared, CJK-aware helper for exactly this problem:
`estimateStringChars` (`src/utils/cjk-chars.ts`), which inflates the counted
length of CJK/Hangul/Hiragana/Katakana/fullwidth characters so the standard
`chars / 4` formula stays accurate for any script. It's already used by the
generic OpenAI-completions transport for the same class of estimate — Ollama's
local estimator was a straggler that never got migrated onto it.

This change:
- Exposes `estimateStringChars` through the existing
  `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` barrel (the plugin-SDK boundary
  Ollama's extension code must go through).
- Swaps the raw `.length` calls in the Ollama prompt/completion usage fallback
  (and JSON-serialized tool-call/tool fields via `safeJsonLength`) for
  `estimateStringChars`, keeping the same local rounding formula
  (`Math.max(1, Math.round(chars / 4))`) unchanged.
- Proves the production caller path (`createOllamaStreamFn` → NDJSON final
  chunk without eval counts → `done.message.usage`) instead of exporting the
  local estimators just for helper-unit tests.

No new estimation logic was invented — this reuses the existing shared helper
rather than adding a second CJK-detection implementation.

## User Impact

No change for ASCII/Latin content (the fallback estimate is unchanged for
that case). For CJK-heavy Ollama conversations that hit the native-usage
fallback path, usage/context accounting and proactive compaction triggering
are now accurate instead of undercounting by 2-4x. When Ollama does report
valid `prompt_eval_count`/`eval_count`, those values remain authoritative.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/ollama/src/stream.ts`, `extensions/ollama/src/stream.test.ts`,
  `src/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime.ts`, `scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs`,
  `docs/.generated/plugin-sdk-api-baseline.sha256`
- Production caller path: `createOllamaStreamFn` → NDJSON stream parse →
  `estimateOllamaPromptTokens` / `estimateOllamaCompletionTokens` (fallback) →
  `buildAssistantMessage` → `done.message.usage`
- Shared helper: `estimateStringChars` via `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime`
- Compatibility: provider-reported eval counts still win over the fallback

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior or issue addressed

When an Ollama native stream's final chunk omits `prompt_eval_count` /
`eval_count`, the production stream path now writes CJK-aware fallback usage
onto `done.message.usage` (roughly 1 token per CJK char) instead of the old
raw UTF-16 `length / 4` undercount. Valid provider-reported eval counts still
override the fallback. ASCII-only fallback usage is unchanged.

### Canonical reachability path

`createOllamaStreamFn` → NDJSON final chunk without eval counts →
`estimateOllamaPromptTokens` / `estimateOllamaCompletionTokens` →
`buildAssistantMessage` → `done.message.usage`

### Shared helper / provider constraint check

Reuses `estimateStringChars` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime`
(same helper already used by the OpenAI-completions transport). Local
`CHARS_PER_TOKEN_ESTIMATE = 4` stays private so the public SDK growth is a
single callable export, with matching surface-budget pins.

### Real environment tested

Production Ollama stream path driven with a real `Response` + NDJSON
`ReadableStream` (via the existing SSRF-guarded fetch seam mock). Final chunk
intentionally omits eval counts to force the fallback; sibling case keeps
`prompt_eval_count=77` / `eval_count=19` to prove provider counts stay
authoritative. Node v22.23.1.

### Exact steps or command run after this patch

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/ollama/src/stream.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

### Evidence after fix

```text
 ✓ |extension-providers| extensions/ollama/src/stream.test.ts > createOllamaStreamFn thinking events > falls back to CJK-aware usage when the final chunk omits eval counts 2ms
 ✓ |extension-providers| extensions/ollama/src/stream.test.ts > createOllamaStreamFn thinking events > keeps provider-reported eval counts authoritative over the CJK fallback 1ms
 ✓ |extension-providers| extensions/ollama/src/stream.test.ts > createOllamaStreamFn thinking events > matches the plain chars/4 heuristic for ASCII-only fallback usage 0ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  19 passed (19)
```

### Observed result after fix

Against the production stream path, a CJK prompt/completion whose final NDJSON
chunk omits eval counts yields fallback `usage.input` / `usage.output` that
match `estimateStringChars(...)/4` and are more than 2x the naive
`length/4` undercount. When the final chunk includes valid eval counts, those
exact provider numbers are preserved on `done.message.usage`. ASCII-only
fallback usage still matches the historical `chars/4` heuristic.

### What was not tested

Live stall against a real local Ollama daemon omitting eval counts. The
fallback path proven here is the same code that runs after NDJSON parse when
those fields are absent or invalid.

### Fix classification

bugfix — usage accounting / CJK undercount

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted. Author reviewed the narrowed SDK export (only `estimateStringChars`),
caller-path proof, surface-budget pin, and CI knip unused-export fix.
